projectDescription: A powerful Among Us utility mod (DLL) for Windows that injects via proxy or injector to add an in-game ImGui menu with hundreds of features covering ESP, radar, replay, player management, sabotage, task automation, host controls, and more — intended for educational and private-lobby use.
keyFeatures: ESP (Entity Awareness) — bounding boxes, tracers, distances, and role-based overlays for all players
Radar — live minimap with player positions, dead bodies, ghosts, and click-to-teleport
Replay System — records and plays back player movements with a scrubable timeline
Self Tab — NoClip, Freecam, Zoom, God Mode, role selection, cosmetic presets, teleport, and visual toggles
Players Tab — per-player actions: kill, teleport, votekick, shift outfit, set role, spectate, and trolling options
Game/Host Tab — lobby management, role assignment, anticheat (SMAC), moderation ranks, custom game options
Sabotage & Doors — trigger/repair any sabotage, pin/unpin doors, auto-repair, and spam controls
Tasks Tab — complete all tasks, bypass visual task checks, play animations, task enforcer
Spoofing & Account — spoof level, platform, friend code, PSN/Xbox IDs, and guest accounts
Customizable Keybinds — all hotkeys configurable via JSON config or in-game Settings → Keybinds
Version Proxy DLL — auto-loads without an injector when placed in the Among Us directory
Multi-platform Support — Steam (x86), itch.io, Epic Games (x64), Microsoft Store/Xbox (x64)
publicApiSurface: SickoMenu.dll — standard DLL injected via any injector (x86 for Steam/itch, x64 for Epic/Xbox/MS Store)
version.dll — proxy DLL placed in Among Us directory; auto-loaded by the game on startup
sicko-config/<name>.json — JSON configuration file storing all settings and keybind virtual key codes
KeyBinds::Config struct — VK_* fields for every toggle (menu, radar, console, noclip, panic, etc.)
Settings class — serialized/deserialized state for all menu toggles, spoofing options, and UI preferences
Events system (_events.h) — KillEvent, VentEvent, CastVoteEvent, WalkEvent, ReportDeadBodyEvent, etc.
RPC wrappers (rpc/) — RpcMurderPlayer, RpcSetRole, RpcCompleteTask, RpcSetName, RpcSetColor, RpcSnapTo, etc.
GameOptions class — typed accessors/setters wrapping IGameOptions (SetByte, SetFloat, SetBool, GetInt, etc.)
Utility functions (utility.h) — GetAllPlayerControl, RepairSabotage, CompleteAllTasks, GetPlayerColor, etc.
il2cpp helpers (framework/) — il2cpp-init, il2cpp-helpers for resolving game types and method pointers
Debug tab — profiler, RPC queue clearing, occlusion culling toggle (Debug builds only)
SickoChat (/sc <message>) — in-game chat command for broadcasting custom messages
